text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:

Swiss exports increased about eight percent from January to June 1997 compared to the same period of last year. Imports rose about 10 percent in comparison to the same period, says a report from the Swiss customs office.
Company bankruptcies rose 8.2 percent to 2,197 in the first six months of 1997 compared to the same period in 1996. The number of new companies founded rose 7.5 percent to 14,947.
Plans by TA-Media AG, a publishing house, and Roger Schawinski, the boss of the first local TV-Channel in Zurich, for a new nationwide private TV-channel have failed.
Switzerland has the highest price level in Western Europe, says a study by the Federal Statistics Office in comparison with 1995. In terms of wealth Luxembourg is ahead of Switzerland.
